g.text: Connect master Uno D1/TX to the addressed receiver Uno D0/RX. The connector pin numbers are a logical map: pin 1 carries serial data and pin 2 is ground. The joined ground gives both boards a shared signal reference.

g.desc: Connect master Uno D1/TX to the addressed receiver Uno D0/RX. The connector pin numbers are a logical map: pin 1 carries serial data and pin 2 is ground. The joined ground gives both boards a shared signal reference.

g.text: Use separate regulated board supplies or suitable USB power. Disconnect the receiver USB data connection during the direct TX-to-RX test because its USB-to-serial bridge also drives D0/RX. Do not connect TX outputs together or use RS-232 voltage levels. The drawing omits board power connections and shows only the signal and shared ground.
